changes.reason: Recognize named runtime exports and aliases when compiling decorated providers. Symbol selection and literal generated references are build-time contracts independent of deployment infrastructure.

kubernetes.reason: This change resolves TypeScript module export symbols at build time. It does not change the execution contract of Kubernetes Node Hosts.
constraints: Generated factories retain the existing DI graph contract; no host capability, storage or lifecycle behavior is added.
No new runtime support, live infrastructure evidence or provider certification is claimed.
